alt: Our diagram of the GTA 6 money glitch loop in four steps: loot both teddy bear vans, switch characters and back, loot again, store full bags in a van and sell. Not a game screenshot.

data.title: The respawn loop

steps.title: Switch and back
steps.body: Partner far away. Switch, then switch straight back.

steps.title: Loot again
steps.body: The 6 packs are back. Fill both bags.

steps.title: Store, then sell
steps.body: 10 bags per plain van. Sell to a fence.

data.tip: From GameSpot, 23 Nov 2026. Our drawing, not a game screenshot.
